items.title: How far does the JobSeeker allowance actually go?
items.description: JobSeeker exists to support Australian's when they can't find work, but how far does that money actually go? The number of long-term JobSeeker recipients has almost tripled since 2012, despite hundreds of millions of dollars being paid to private equity-controlled firms to find people jobs. So, how are the 900,000 people on JobSeeker making ends meet?
